title: Rolling in the Deep

cues.en: There's a fire starting in my heart
cues.zh: 我心中有一團火在燃燒
cues.text: There's a fire starting in my heart

cues.en: Reaching a fever pitch and it's bringing me out the dark
cues.zh: 達到狂熱程度，它讓我走出黑暗
cues.text: Reaching a fever pitch and it's bringing me out the dark

cues.en: Finally I can see you crystal clear
cues.zh: 終於我能看到你晶瑩剔透
cues.text: Finally I can see you crystal clear

cues.en: Go ahead and shout me out and I'll lay your shit bare
cues.zh: 來吧，大聲喊我，我會揭露你的狗屎
cues.text: Go ahead and shout me out and I'll lay your shit bare

cues.en: See how I'll leave with every piece of you
cues.zh: 看我如何帶著你的每一片離開
cues.text: See how I'll leave with every piece of you

cues.en: Don't underestimate the things that I will do
cues.zh: 不要低估我會做的事情
cues.text: Don't underestimate the things that I will do

cues.en: There's a fire starting in my heart
cues.zh: 我心中有一團火在燃燒
cues.text: There's a fire starting in my heart

cues.zh: 達到狂熱程度，它讓我走出黑暗
cues.text: Reaching a fever pitch and it's bringing me out the dark

cues.en: The scars of your love remind me of us
cues.zh: 你的愛的傷痕讓我想起我們
cues.text: The scars of your love remind me of us

cues.en: They keep me thinking that we almost add it all
cues.zh: 他們讓我覺得我們幾乎把所有的都加起來了
cues.text: They keep me thinking that we almost add it all

cues.en: The scars of your love, they leave me breathless
cues.zh: 你的愛的傷痕讓我喘不過氣來
cues.text: The scars of your love, they leave me breathless

cues.en: I can't help feeling we could have had it by
cues.zh: 我情不自禁地覺得我們本來可以這樣度過的
cues.text: I can't help feeling we could have had it by

cues.en: Yeah, I'll have that feeling in the day
cues.zh: 是的，那天我會有那種感覺
cues.text: Yeah, I'll have that feeling in the day

cues.en: You'll have my heart in the day
cues.zh: 有一天你會得到我的心
cues.text: You'll have my heart in the day

cues.en: Yeah, I'll have that feeling in the day
cues.zh: 是的，那天我會有那種感覺
cues.text: Yeah, I'll have that feeling in the day

cues.en: You'll have that feeling in the day
cues.zh: 當天你就會有這種感覺
cues.text: You'll have that feeling in the day

cues.en: Baby, I have no story to be told
cues.zh: 寶貝，我沒有故事可講
cues.text: Baby, I have no story to be told

cues.en: But I've heard one on you
cues.zh: 但我聽過一個關於你的事
cues.text: But I've heard one on you

cues.en: And I'm gonna make your head burn
cues.zh: 我會讓你頭痛
cues.text: And I'm gonna make your head burn

cues.en: Think of me in the depths of your despair
cues.zh: 在你絕望的深處想想我
cues.text: Think of me in the depths of your despair

cues.en: Make a home down there as mine sure won't be shared
cues.zh: 在那裡安個家，因為我的家肯定不會被分享
cues.text: Make a home down there as mine sure won't be shared

cues.zh: 你的愛的傷痕讓我喘不過氣來
cues.text: The scars of your love, they leave me breathless

cues.text: I can't help feeling we could have had it by

cues.en: Yeah, I'll have that feeling in the day
cues.zh: 是的，那天我會有那種感覺
cues.text: Yeah, I'll have that feeling in the day

cues.en: You'll have that heart in the day
cues.zh: 有一天你就會擁有那顆心
cues.text: You'll have that heart in the day

cues.en: You'll have that feeling in the day
cues.zh: 當天你就會有這種感覺
cues.text: You'll have that feeling in the day

cues.en: You have a heart instead of your head But you played it with your beating
cues.zh: 你有一顆心而不是你的頭腦但你用你的跳動來演奏它
cues.text: You have a heart instead of your head But you played it with your beating

cues.en: Throw your soul through every open door Count your blessings to fight what you look for
cues.zh: 把你的靈魂扔進每一扇敞開的門計算你的祝福來對抗你所尋找的東西
cues.text: Throw your soul through every open door Count your blessings to fight what you look for

cues.en: Turn my sorrow into treasure though We'll pay me back in kind and reap this what you saw
cues.zh: 把我的悲傷變成寶藏，但我們會以同樣的方式回報我，並收穫你所看到的
cues.text: Turn my sorrow into treasure though We'll pay me back in kind and reap this what you saw

cues.en: We could have had it done We could have had it done
cues.zh: 我們本來可以完成的 我們本來可以完成的
cues.text: We could have had it done We could have had it done
